description: Fork of exp144 (E=64 SOTA, val_bpb=1.7101 at 392M). Single change: replace F.scaled_dot_product_attention with BitAttention. Q, K are 496-dim ±1 dominance vectors (V2D output of d_qk=32 Borda) so the binary Tensor Core forward kernel applies losslessly. attn_scale stays learnable, passed as a 0-d tensor so its gradient flows through BitAttention. Effective scale = attn_scale / sqrt(P) where P=496 (V2D output dim). Forward: binary TC + bf16 WMMA V agg (kernel TC-v5). Backward: bf16 cuBLAS GEMM = WGMMA + torch.compile (kernel speedup ~3x vs fp32). Val_bpb should match exp144 within bf16 quantization noise (~1e-3 rel). Launch with SPIKY_BIT_ATTN_USE_FORWARD_KERNEL=tc SPIKY_BIT_ATTN_USE_BACKWARD_KERNEL=bf16 env vars.
